text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: decode-gpu-12 reported repeated CUDA_OOM during streaming decode (multiple containers). error rate spike 3x over baseline, first seen 6632104320. auto-pager triggered.

matt_oncall: I’m on it, joining bridge in 2m. any CS impact yet?

julia_sre: seeing continuous OOM across shards on that node, logs show token spiral on several requests - max_tokens set to 5000 in some routes.

lia_prod: CS reporting ~2% request drops for customers hitting streaming chat. major customer A saw 6 failed requests in last 10m. filing incident ticket.

ben_support: jotting a quick customer-facing blurb: "We are investigating increased request failures for streaming; engineers working on mitigation." will update in 15.

matt_oncall: ok first quick mitigations: (1) route traffic off decode-gpu-12, (2) reduce default max_tokens for streaming endpoints to 1024, (3) enable model-level dropout to fallback model. executing now.

sara_infra: re-routing via lb rule change: `rbalance --set-exclude decode-gpu-12` applied. verifying connection drain.

incident-bot: action logged: lb-exclude by sara_infra at 6632104399.

julia_sre: started live patch to per-route config: setting X-Client-Max-Tokens header cap to 1024 for streaming routes. snippet: ```sh
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routes/patch -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","override": {"max_tokens":1024}}' -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
```

matt_oncall: toggled generation-guard on that cluster to enforce token ceiling at runtime. adding temporary throttle to prevent runaway prefix loops.

lia_prod: sending initial customer update: "We’ve mitigated the immediate node impact by routing traffic and applying token caps; small number of in-flight requests were dropped, we’ll follow up with timeline."

ben_support: noted. customers asked for incident severity — recommend P2 for now, escalate if more than 5% drop.

julia_sre: root cause hypothesis: a small subset of requests had empty stop tokens + mis-specified max_tokens header causing runaway decode, ballooned KV cache and triggered CUDA_OOM. collecting traces now.

incident-bot: traces aggregation job started: trace-collector-2026-03-17-663210 started. ETA 3m.

sara_infra: restarted container decode-12-pod-7 gracefully to recover fragmented GPU memory, monitoring for cuda error on restart.

matt_oncall: note for oncall: if OOM recurs after restart, perform `kubectl cordon` and rotate node out of pool; do NOT reboot host until logs uploaded.

julia_sre: attaching relevant log excerpt: ```
[2026-03-17T12:05:21Z] WARN decoder: request id=xx token-count=4820 stop_tokens=[] kv_cache=4.1GB
[2026-03-17T12:05:22Z] ERROR cuda: Cuda out of memory while allocating 512MB (stream=0)
[2026-03-17T12:05:22Z] FATAL runtime: aborting request id=xx
```

lia_prod: product note: this affected streaming only; non-streaming batch endpoints unaffected. letting customers know we separated the impact.

ben_support: customer A updated with details + ETA 30m. they requested root cause and mitigations.

matt_oncall: mitigation checklist: 1) node drain & restart (in progress), 2) patch default max_tokens (done), 3) add guardrails in SDK to prevent empty stop sequences (todo), 4) add metric alert for runaway-token-rate (todo).

julia_sre: creating follow-up ticket: INF-7422 "guardrail: prevent empty stop_tokens + max_tokens validation." assigning to eng-runtime.

incident-bot: incident timeline entry: 6632104321 - pager triggered; 6632104399 - LB exclusion; 6632104412 - token cap applied; 6632104480 - pod restart initiated.

sara_infra: pod restart completed, monitoring GPU mem usage now trending down. no new OOMs in last 4m.

matt_oncall: leaving note for next oncall: watch for correlated spikes around 6632104000-6632104600, review traces in trace-collector job, follow-up with SDK team to add client-side limits.

lia_prod: preparing post-incident customer summary draft for CS review. will include timeline and immediate mitigations + planned fix INF-7422.

ben_support: will send CS summary after review. recommended follow-up ticket to engage account team for affected customers.

julia_sre: closing live mitigation. moving to postmortem phase. marking incident as resolved if no new OOMs in 30m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident status updated to "mitigated" at 6632104920.

matt_oncall: thanks team. logging runbook gaps: automated token validation missing, no per-request KV cache watermark alert. adding to postmortem action items.

ops-runbook-bot: new runbook task created: RB-1149 "add runtime kv-cache watermark alert and automated token-cap enforcement" assigned to sara_infra + eng-runtime.

lia_prod: will schedule customer follow-up for tomorrow EOD.

ben_support: filing CS notes and closing loop for now.

julia_sre: final note: consider adding quick server-side safety net to immediately truncate generation when token_count > 2*expected_limit to avoid KV explosion. small patch could avoid future runaways.

matt_oncall: agreed. tagging eng-reliability for next sprint. good work everyone. :thumbsup:
